rows.name: server.prepareTriage
rows.reason: it starts an in-app triage of the T3 Code install itself: the server writes the session files `t3 triage` writes (its own logs, config and version under T3 home) and clones the T3 Code source from github.com/pingdotgg/t3code into its cache, then hands the phone a prompt for a scratch thread. t3-serve is not that server (it has no T3 home, logs or release to diagnose) and rca-exec has nothing of it to read; the feature would be a network clone of a third party's repository with no state of ours to triage, so there is nothing to build and prove on the executor. The phone's own fallback is the `npx t3 triage` command it offers to copy. Owner-confirmed (decision 7).
